meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 启用一套预设的工作模式指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你希望助手能在需要时切换到一个高要求的工作状态。
copy.tagline_en: Apply a preset work-mode directive to your assistant
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to follow a binding directive when you request a special mode.

howto.what: 开启 ultrawork 模式后,它开头的第一行必定是「ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!」;随后登记目标与验收标准、建立持久笔记和待办清单,并用 curl、浏览器、终端、GUI 自动化等真实渠道抓证据,证明交付物端到端可用。
howto.when: 当你明确要求开启 ultrawork 模式、且该指令尚未出现在对话中时,它接管;接管后先给任务定级(LIGHT 或 HEAVY),再按该级别规划与验证。

say.text: 开启 ultrawork 模式,帮我修掉这个 bug 并给出证据
用 ultrawork 模式做一个新接口,测试先行
say.note: 会先写会失败的测试,再实现

say.text: ultrawork 模式做这次改动,按 HEAVY 级别验证
say.note: 会列 3 项以上验收场景并逐一抓证据

howto.what_en: With ultrawork mode on, its first line is “ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”. It registers a goal with success criteria, keeps a notepad and todo list, and captures real-surface evidence (curl, browser, terminal) to prove the work end to end.
howto.when_en: When you explicitly ask for ultrawork mode and the directive is not yet in the conversation, it takes over; it first classifies the task as LIGHT or HEAVY, then plans and verifies accordingly.

say_en.text: Turn on ultrawork mode and fix this bug with evidence.
say_en.note: It prints ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED! then runs the flow.

say_en.text: In ultrawork mode, build a new endpoint test-first.
say_en.note: It writes a failing test first, then implements.

say_en.text: Run this change in ultrawork mode, verified at HEAVY.
say_en.note: It lists 3+ success criteria and captures evidence.
